title: Human AI Construction of Bayesian Networks for Operational Decision Support -- A Virtual Survey Approach
summary: 提出用LLM构建贝叶斯网络，结合AI代理和裁剪均值法，用于决策支持。
highlights: 利用LLM作为AI代理估算概率，替代专家判断
应用裁剪均值去除噪声
在替代医疗系统中建模客户意向，发现主观规范影响更大
score_reason: 论文提出用LLM代理构建贝叶斯网络，直接涉及AI和决策支持
author: Kumar Rahul (Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode, Kerala, India), Shovan Chowdhury (Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode, Kerala, India)
